verdict.rationale: Gemini documents official coding-agent integrations. Gemini API Skills are offered for Claude Code, Cursor and Antigravity, and a Gemini Docs MCP server serves documentation to agents. The `gemini-api` CLI is built so coding agents can call the model and delegate tasks to managed agents. First-class SDKs exist for Python, JS/TS, Go and Java, plus OpenAI-library compatibility. However, the skills and docs MCP server mainly inject documentation rather than plug the model in, and no agent-framework integrations are evidenced. missing for 10: documented first-party integrations with named agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain, CrewAI or similar), plugin-style model-provider integration inside coding agents beyond docs-skills and the CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the model into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, official integrations — skills, plugins, or first-class SDK support

citations.quote: To ensure your AI coding helper (such as Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, or other IDE extensions) generates up-to-date code using the correct SDK syntax and best practices, we recommend equipping your assistant with **Gemini API Skills**.
Your coding agent can use it to generate text and media, analyze files, and delegate tasks to [Gemini managed agents].
The Google GenAI SDK is available for the Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go and Java languages.
install the [Gemini API development skill](/gemini-api/docs/coding-agents) to give your agent access to the latest documentation and best practices.
